datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Kenya in 2017. Geographic boundaries were classified into IPC phases (1-5) representing acute food insecurity severity levels, with multiple scenario projections provided for near-term forecasting. Data was compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) for February, June, and October 2017.
